expected_behavior: Runs scripts/shader-check.mjs over the shader files in scope before reading them, and copies its rule findings with their rule names, severities and file:line.
Reads every file against references/checklist.md in the order correctness, portability, precision, cost, and names the stage and target of every cost or precision finding.
Copies the check's rated and unrated lists verbatim and never calls a file with no validator clean.
Inside o-review it writes every finding under the plan's [Shaders] heading, or none, and edits no code; o-fix applies the fixes.
